<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

Doctrine: .agents/skills/pij-team/TENETS.md. TypeScript-only, inside the pi/omp extension. Touch: `.pi/extensions/pij/index.ts` (two call sites :321 and :364-371) + a new small module `.pi/extensions/pij/core/session-name.ts` holding the pure retry/fallback helper so it is testable with a fake pi API, + its test. The helper takes narrow deps: {setSessionName, getSessionName?, setStatus, notice, sleep} — never the whole ctx. Read the vendored diagnosis assets/inputs/diagnosis.md first; the omp bridge and boolean exits are documented there with the exact dist snippets. Runtime detection stays `detectPiRuntime` (core/discovery.ts:51-57). NO changes outside these paths; if getSessionName is not exposed through the extension API, say so and fall back to bounded blind retries + status + notice.
